conservative.read: This plan aims for capital preservation with a target of around 1.5% per month. It significantly reduces leverage and concentrates on income and broad index exposure, aiming for lower drawdowns.

plan: Trim leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL, MUU, METU) to low single digits.
Trim SPY to 25% to manage concentration.
Buy GEV as a new, high-scoring addition.

balanced.read: This balanced approach targets around 2.5% per month, focusing on risk management while pursuing growth. It reduces leverage and concentration, adding a new high-quality setup, with a moderate cash buffer.

plan: Trim SPY to 25% to free up capital.

aggressive.read: This aggressive plan targets around 4% per month, embracing leverage and concentration in high-scoring setups. It accepts higher risk and potential for larger drawdowns, with a smaller cash buffer. Leveraged ETF decay is a key risk.

plan: Sell all leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL, MUU, METU) and high-beta names (CRWD, SNOW).

income.read: This income-focused plan targets around 1% per month, prioritizing stable monthly distributions and low drawdowns. It shifts entirely to income-generating ETFs and broad index exposure, cutting all leverage and high-beta single names.
